You are playing BLINDBOARD, a deduction game about a hidden keyboard.

THE BOARD
The board is a QWERTY keyboard's 26 letters plus the 13-key number row (39 keys), addressed by touch-typing finger and row (rows: num, top, home, bottom); '-in' marks index-finger inner reach; '-out'/'-o1'/'-o2' mark pinky outer-reach columns. Each key is addressed by finger and row. The complete list of valid key addresses:
L-pinky-num-out, L-pinky-num, L-pinky-top, L-pinky-home, L-pinky-bottom, L-ring-num, L-ring-top, L-ring-home, L-ring-bottom, L-middle-num, L-middle-top, L-middle-home, L-middle-bottom, L-index-num, L-index-top, L-index-home, L-index-bottom, L-index-num-in, L-index-top-in, L-index-home-in, L-index-bottom-in, R-index-num-in, R-index-top-in, R-index-home-in, R-index-bottom-in, R-index-num, R-index-top, R-index-home, R-index-bottom, R-middle-num, R-middle-top, R-middle-home, R-ring-num, R-ring-top, R-ring-home, R-pinky-num, R-pinky-top, R-pinky-num-o1, R-pinky-num-o2

EACH TURN
- You press exactly 4 DIFFERENT keys (a chord) by giving their addresses.
- Next turn you are told which 4 symbols those keys held, as a list sorted in the same fixed order as the symbol list above. You are NOT told which symbol came from which key. Overlap your chords cleverly to pin symbols to keys.

ROTATIONS
After your presses each turn, some keys may be ROTATED: the letters on the rotated keys are rearranged among those same keys, and every rotated key ends up with a different letter than it had (the set of letters on those keys is unchanged; only their places among those keys change). Next turn you are told exactly WHICH keys were rotated, but not how they were rearranged. Rotations become rarer as the game goes on and eventually stop.

LOCKS (optional, side score)
On any press turn you may lock letters onto keys you are sure of: +1 point if correct at that moment, -3 if wrong. You get no feedback on locks during the game. Each key can be locked only once, ever.

FINAL GUESS
You may end the game at any time by submitting your full guess. After turn 24 you MUST submit it. Your main score is how many of the 39 keys you guess correctly, judged against the arrangement at the moment you guess.

To press: {"presses": ["L-pinky-num-out", "L-pinky-bottom", "L-ring-bottom"]}
